LYDI CAPSTONE 2026 · TEAM HEART

Health care that meets the market where it works.

Project HEART brings blood pressure and blood glucose screening, health education and a clear path to the nearest Primary Health Centre to traders and artisans in Iba LCDA, Lagos.

Join the OutreachBecome a Health Steward

FreeConfidentialCommunity-led

00.0%of traders we surveyed said they would join free community screening.

01 — THE PROBLEM

The clinic is there. The habit of using it isn't.

Primary Health Centres are available, yet preventive checks are often delayed. Community interviews point to self-medication and informal providers because they feel faster and easier to reach.

00.0%of surveyed traders diagnosed with hypertension
00.0%buy medicines from roadside vendors or agbo sellers
00.0%have never checked their blood pressure
0 in 0Nigerian adults lives with hypertension — over half do not know
“The challenge was not a lack of interest in health, but limited access to convenient preventive healthcare.”

What gets in the way

  • Long PHC waiting times
  • Work commitments
  • Convenience of informal care
  • Misconceptions about preventive care

02 — THE MODEL

More than a one-day outreach.

HEART connects education, screening and care in one continuous community pathway.

H·E01

Health Education

Clear, practical education on hypertension, diabetes and prevention, in English and Yoruba.

WHAT HAPPENS

  • Understand common risk factors
  • Ask questions in familiar language

OUTPUT100+ traders reached

A02

Assessment

Every participant receives a risk assessment, screening and a simple explanation of their results.

WHAT HAPPENS

  • Blood pressure check
  • Blood glucose screening

OUTPUTBP + glucose for every participant

R03

Referral

People who need further care leave with a clear, documented route to the partner PHC.

WHAT HAPPENS

  • Results reviewed in consultation
  • PHC referral card provided

OUTPUTDocumented referral with tracking code

T04

Tracking

Support continues after the outreach through calls, reminders and trusted community voices.

WHAT HAPPENS

  • SMS and phone reminders
  • Steward support after referral

OUTPUTFollow-up within 14 days

Then back to the community: Stewards keep it going
One pathway. Four stages. No one left at the clinic door.See how it works

03 — THE JOURNEY

From first conversation to follow-up.

  1. 01

    Mobilisation with market leaders

  2. 02

    Health education session

  3. 03

    Blood pressure and blood glucose screening

  4. 04

    Consultation, with results explained simply

  5. 05

    Referral card with PHC tracking code, if needed

  6. 06

    Follow-up within 14 days, plus SMS reminders

ON THE DAY

What to expect

  • Completely free
  • About 20 minutes
  • Private and confidential
  • Consent form signed first
  • Results explained in simple language

04 — COMMUNITY HEALTH STEWARDS

Trusted faces. Local voices.

Project HEART is sustained by volunteer Health Stewards from within the market community.

What they do

  • Translate health information accurately
  • Remind peers about PHC visits
  • Answer simple questions

What they receive

  • Training on hypertension & diabetes
  • Basic communication guide
  • Certificate of participation
Apply to be a Steward

Local voices. Practical support. Lasting trust.

05 — THE HEALTH HUB

Simple guidance, after the market closes.

The Health Hub keeps essential information close: what your numbers mean, when to seek care, and how to contact the nearest PHC.

Scan the poster in the market to open the Health Hub. No smartphone? You will also get SMS reminders and PHC hotline numbers.

General information only, not a substitute for medical advice.
